title: A Non-asymptotic Analysis for Learning and Applying a Preconditioner in MCMC
abstract: arXiv:2602.10714v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Preconditioning is a common method applied to modify Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms with the goal of making them more efficient. In practice it is often extremely effective, even when the preconditioner is learned from the chain. We analyse and compare the finite-time computational costs of schemes which learn a preconditioner based on the target covariance or the expected Hessian of the target potential with that of a corresponding scheme that does not use preconditioning. We apply our results to various algorithms including the Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm (ULA) and the proximal sampler for an appropriately regular target, establishing non-asymptotic guarantees for versions of these algorithms that learn and use preconditioners. translated_title: 马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛中预条件子学习与应用的非渐近分析
translated_abstract: 预条件处理是修改马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛算法以提升其效率的常用方法。在实践中，即使预条件子是从链中学习得到的，这种方法也往往极为有效。我们分析并比较了基于目标协方差或目标势函数的期望Hessian矩阵学习预条件子的方案，与不使用预条件处理的相应方案在有限时间内的计算成本。我们将结果应用于多种算法，包括未调整的朗之万算法（ULA）和针对适当正则目标的近端采样器，为这些算法在学习并使用预条件子的版本建立了非渐近保证。为此，我们在假设下，为学习预条件子的方案从目标中收集$N$个近似独立样本所需时间建立了非渐近保证。
tldr: 本文为非渐近框架下学习并使用预条件子的MCMC算法（如ULA和近端采样器）提供了计算成本分析，证明了其效率优于无预条件方案。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a non-asymptotic analysis of computational costs for MCMC algorithms that learn and use preconditioners (e.g., ULA and proximal sampler), showing efficiency gains over non-preconditioned schemes.
